issues.detail: The PC210LC-11 remains referenced on Komatsu's New Zealand site while the PC220LC-12 supersedes it in the current United States lineup. This is a clearly labeled -11 conventional research candidate, not a claim of current US sale.
The shared brochure also documents PC210LCi-11. GNSS antennas, iMC sensors and intelligent-machine-control hardware are excluded from this conventional PC210LC-11 candidate.
Every front-equipment pivot, cylinder anchor, bucket linkage dimension, swing-bearing detail, track route, roller center, hose path, motion curve and collision envelope remains reconstructed.
